lesson: Risky tool execution must pass through deterministic permission evaluation and sandbox policy before any provider callback or runner grants access.
Run the focused Prettier check after adding or reshaping TypeScript tests so the deterministic structural gate does not rediscover formatting drift.

Node exposes no linkat(AT_SYMLINK_FOLLOW) (path link on /proc/self/fd gives EXDEV) and no renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE); a filesystem inode-bound no-replace publish is impossible in portable Node without a native binding. For hardened file publish, use write-temp then rename via /proc/self/fd/<dirfd> on Linux (dirfd-pinned, no escape) and deliver no-replace via unique random storage names; treat Darwin (no /proc, no *at) as a naming-bounded dev-only ceiling. Do not keep looping autoreview demanding *at primitives.
source: SEC-1 autoreview cycles 4-6 + Codex signal S-0002

lesson: A successfully edited terminal Discord base handle stays terminal even when multipart overflow rejects or is ambiguous; create reconciliation must derive terminality from the base edit, not overflow completion.
Keep provider-specific and channel-specific behavior behind adapters; domain and application code should depend on stable product concepts and ports, not SDK payloads or runtime wiring.

Fleet compose rehearsal must run settings-seed through the normal Docker entrypoint so local auto-secrets are exported, and seed desired-state via the import service rather than the broad CLI bootstrap; the CLI bootstrap can close the shared runtime storage pool before settings import validation finishes. Docker-internal first-party Postgres hostnames need explicit plaintext allowance while real remote Postgres still requires sslmode=require.

Do not discard a stale successful Discord create by sequence alone: when its superseding create definitively delivered zero parts and no newer handle exists, adopt the older valid message ID and clear definitive-missing so terminal repair cannot double-post.

Runner-spawning tests (agent-runner-ipc, ipc-mcp-stdio) sandbox the runner by COPYING source files; hand-enumerated lists silently break when a new module becomes runner-reachable (every test then burns its ~19s IPC timeout). Fixed 2026-07-22 by recursive cpSync of the whole shared/ tree. If a runner-spawn test suite suddenly times out uniformly, check the sandbox copy set FIRST; never reintroduce per-file enumeration of a derivable file set.
source: PAY-1 verify failure + fix commit (46 uniform timeouts after stage-E shared/ splits)

lesson: In Browser usage enforce mode, backend current-tab URLs must normalize to a registrable site; internal or local URLs must fail closed instead of falling back to stale remembered or unknown site state.
source: review: Neutral Browser Hardening P2 unnormalizable active tab URL

lesson: IPC/MCP stdio fixture tests that spawn child processes need stdout/stderr draining, explicit timeout headroom for full-suite load, and buffered child output in timeout errors.

Timing-adaptive unit tests (ipc-auth-boundary 'adaptively drains a large grace-expired replay backlog', agent-runner-ipc heartbeat) fail under high system load in the full test:unit run but pass isolated. Re-run the single file idle before treating such a failure as a regression, and check load average and swap first.
source: LAT-3A stage 2, full unit run at load average 82

lesson: Delete an overtaken Discord post only after a newer mutation is accepted; otherwise adopt the landed card, and preserve partial-delivery message IDs through rejection so the same decision can clean or adopt every visible chunk.

When memory IPC auth scope includes per-run reviewer authority, every runner boundary must forward memoryReviewerIsControlApprover into the Gantry MCP server env; otherwise approver runs sign memory_search and continuity_summary requests with a different scope than runtime verification.

Content-addressed artifact path segments must keep reserved filename characters percent-encoded consistently across local and object-store backends; do not restore colon for readability because Windows rejects it.

When Docker access is denied, a disposable local PostgreSQL 17 cluster can still be blocked during initdb because the sandbox rejects SysV shared memory; shared_memory_type and dynamic_shared_memory_type mmap options do not affect the bootstrap subprocess.

For multipart Discord progress, a nonterminal update tracks the landed overflow message as the active handle, while a terminal update retains the edited base; only fall back to the base for nonterminal delivery when no overflow ID exists.

Managed command policy can reject required VITEST_JUNIT/FORGE_TEST_ID commands when the exact testcase identifier contains a literal greater-than separator. Report the wrapper lane as blocked and do not call it passing.
When Discord progress state is restored from a tombstone, re-arm bounded retention before settlement can leave a retained terminal handle live; retained repair targets must never become timerless.

Telegram media ingestion tests must wait for the observable delivery or file result when real filesystem writes are enabled; fixed microtask or timer counts return before descriptor-based writes finish.

IPC replay markers are addressed by signed per-request randomUUID nonces and freshness validation precedes reservation, so any marker past sweep-grace (2x freshness window) can never be legitimately re-reserved: reviewer findings about pathname rm races on grace-expired markers are outside the threat model (need id reuse = key possession or 2^-122 collision). EEXIST always rejects; do not add cross-worker locks for this.

Code review (local commits AND PR/branch closeout) MUST be run by invoking the autoreview SKILL helper directly ($AUTOREVIEW --mode branch|commit|local), NOT by triggering a codex-rescue review job. The rescue review job wraps autoreview but HANGS at final serialization (~40min, no verdict) and its result command drops the job post-completion; the skill helper runs the engine in an isolated read-only sandbox with structured validation and a definitive exit code (0 clean / nonzero on accepted findings). User directive 2026-07-24.
Managed sandboxes that deny listen on 127.0.0.1 make the MCP loopback unit fixture fail with EPERM and then time out; report this as blocked test evidence rather than a product assertion failure.

The full npm run test:unit lane can finish the LIVE-1 surfaces and then remain silent without a Vitest summary in this checkout; do not call it green without the exit code, and preserve focused lane evidence separately.

Keep Discord create tombstones while their provider call is inside the abort-deadline window; if an already-invalidated create later returns a message ID, delete it best-effort instead of silently orphaning a visible card.

When replacing Postgres runtime schema in one cut, move active runtime persistence behind canonical Drizzle repositories/services in the same change; leaving schema-owned raw SQL or old table definitions creates drift and runtime failures after destructive migrations.
source: PR review findings for canonical domain schema cutover

lesson: Do not fetch approved remote MCP hostnames with the original hostname after a single DNS validation; reject hostnames until outbound transport pins the validated address.

Preserve definitive Discord non-delivery beyond ordinary settled-state TTL in the capped per-key tombstone cache, and treat trim-empty terminal repairs as no-ops so retained handles never receive empty edits.

Strict per-card Discord mutation exclusivity requires every progress edit and post to carry a bounded abort signal so one hung provider call cannot wedge the coalesced successor; preserve an overflow ambiguity fingerprint until a different payload's base edit actually completes.
For headed browser sessions, set the visible window size at launch with Chrome args; CDP window bounds or late resize calls do not reliably prevent first-page 0x0/tiny viewport state.

Retain the first Discord part as the repair base for multipart terminal creates and remember that overflow already landed; later terminal repairs edit only that base part and never repost settled overflow.

Implementation MUST go through Codex (/codex:rescue -> implementer.md); a general-purpose Claude write-agent is never a substitute. Degraded mode is still Codex (forge doctor --fix, or Codex CLI directly). Before assuming Codex is unavailable, RUN forge doctor — a read-only research task staying read-only does NOT prove the write lane is broken. PERM-3 T-F1/T-F4/T-F3 were wrongly implemented by general-purpose agents on an untested assumption while the plugin was healthy.

Browser IPC authorization must run before usage settings lookup, active-tab resolution, backend dispatch, or per-site usage metering so stale signed requests after Browser revocation cannot consume buckets.
source: review: Neutral Browser Hardening P2 authorization before metering

lesson: Bound multipart mutation waits per progress key, retain the active base plus overflow IDs as one terminal render, and invalidate ambiguous payload fingerprints whenever a different payload mutates that render.

Selected local_cli capabilities must project credential directories as readable SDK additionalDirectories while keeping them denyWrite, and scheduled parentless SandboxNetworkAccess suppression must be bound to a reviewed command template plus declared host rather than flat host hints.

Supersedes the round-24 timeout handoff and round-31 stale-post cleanup lessons: serialize every Discord provider mutation per route and progress key, keep only the newest queued payload, and leave sender-level late settlement handling above the adapter.

Keep route projection rows distinct from durable AgentConversationBinding records; control binding enable/update should use live-only whole-conversation projection and must skip thread-scoped bindings.

Every Discord progress mutation for a route and progress key must reserve lifecycle order before provider I/O and settle through one reconciliation path; otherwise a late terminal overflow or base edit can overwrite a newer edit or ambiguity.
Runtime state, jobs, control events, and memory use Postgres as the production storage model; schema or repository changes need repository tests and architecture/docs updates when contracts shift.
A shared liveness dispatcher cannot own retry policy while adapters swallow failures or retry internally; classify failures at the adapter boundary and falsify the total transport-attempt ceiling.

An unbounded cache is not dead merely because provider operations are idempotent; trace its reads and writes, preserve its request-ceiling effect, or defer deletion until a stateful test proves redundancy.
